verses.text: Those who live under the protection of God Almighty,
Yahweh will rescue you from all hidden traps
He will shield/protect you like a bird shields/protects its chicks [MET] with/under her wings.
You will not be afraid of things that happen during the night that could ◄terrorize you/cause you to be very afraid►,
You will not be afraid of ◄plagues/widespread sicknesses► that demons cause when they attack people at night,
Even if 1,000 people fall dead alongside you,
If you allow Yahweh to protect you,
nothing evil will happen to you;
because Yahweh will command his angels
They will hold you up with their hands,
You will be kept safe from being harmed by your enemies [MET];
Yahweh says, “I will rescue those who love me,
When they call out to me, I will answer them.
I will reward them by enabling them to live a long time,
